g.text: Multi-surface fields: realized geometry vs candidate-pool potential

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #444444

g.text: Exposed replay: 3 scenes × 4 fixed ROI per condition · higher is better
ROI-then-scene equal weighting. Negative values mean damage. Separate y-axis scales; zero baselines shown.
The 9-position search pool broadens ray offsets; the next oracle increment adds fitted fields. Oracle selection uses reference geometry.
